fields.name: tenant_id
fields.description: Required - The tenant ID of the AAD application.

fields.name: client_id
fields.description: Required - The client ID of the AAD application.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.description: Required - The client secret of the AAD application ([App Secret](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active-directory/develop/howto-create-service-principal-portal#option-2-create-a-new-application-secret)).

fields.name: dcr_id
fields.description: Required - Data Collection Rule (DCR) immutable ID (see [this document](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-monitor/logs/tutorial-logs-ingestion-portal#collect-information-from-the-dcr) to collect the immutable id)

fields.name: table_name
fields.description: Required - The name of the custom log table (include the _CL suffix as well if applicable)

fields.name: time_key
fields.description: Optional - Specify the key name where the timestamp will be stored.

fields.name: time_generated
fields.description: Optional - If enabled, will generate a timestamp and append it to JSON.

fields.name: compress
fields.description: Optional - Enable HTTP payload gzip compression.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of [workers](/manual/3.2/administration/multithreading.md#outputs) to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.
